_doc: Wording pins for `make claims` (src/gegenprobe/claims_pins.py;). pins: phrases that must occur exactly `count` times (default 1), bound where possible to the result they state (`results`: {file, path, is} or {file, vars, expr, is}); `polarity` neg/pos keeps a verdict phrase on the side its result is. guards: every match in `docs` must lie inside a pin phrase or an `allow` phrase. A docs pass that rewrites one of these sentences updates its phrase here; a result that changes fails its pin until the sentence is rewritten. Guards (R18): comparative, maturity, scope_quantifier and deployment words as well; `python -m gegenprobe.claims_pins uncovered` lists matches outside every phrase, `propose` drafts allow entries. Guards also cover labelling (who labelled), adoption (shipped/deployed/adopted/applied/in use/live), evaluative (dominates/improves/higher/lower/far), safety claims (guarantee/certified/hallucination/GDPR/compliant/secure) and cost (free/cheap); `docs` is extended by claims_strict.json `strict_docs`.
